items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: With Howard, Kent Mills, he picked the men's out... I never did work too much with Howard... Kent Mills picked the men's out that he wanted to play.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, well, let me think if there's anything else we haven't covered. Well, I guess mostly just how you came playing with Howard and then, you know, when you come to my dad recording with Howard.

With Howard, Kent Mills, he picked the men's out, you know. You haven't been working with that band? With Howard. I never did work too much with Howard, you know. Yeah. Kent Mills picked the men's out that he wanted to play.
Uh-huh. Did you like making those records? I mean, how'd they sound to you?
